paragraphs: R' Muna. (A Tanna of a baraita.) See the entry R' Mana.[^1]

notes.text: The heading has מונא, Muna, and the target מנא, Mana. Both spellings and the parenthetical “A Tanna of a baraita” are preserved. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
